author: CrakSEO
name: Google Rank Checker: Keyword Rankings & Rank Tracking by CrakSEO
description: Google rank checker for SEO: live keyword rankings and positions for any website, ranked keywords, ranking competitors and keyword gaps. On-demand rank tracking.

tools.name: get_api_credit_balance
tools.description: Free: API credit balance, availability and pricing for SEO data calls. Call first to confirm the connection.

tools.name: check_google_rankings
tools.description: Check Google rankings: the live Google position and ranking URL of a domain for up to 10 keywords in one country, with the top competing domains. Costs API credits per keyword.

domain.description: Domain or URL, for example example.com. Protocol and www are ignored.

items.description: Search query exactly as a user would type it.

keywords.description: Up to 10 keywords to check, one live Google search each.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

location.description: Optional exact location name for city-level results, for example "Austin,Texas,United States". Overrides country.

depth.description: How deep to look for the domain, 10 to 100 results. Default 30.

tools.name: get_ranked_keywords
tools.description: Ranked keywords: every Google keyword a domain or URL ranks for in one country, with position, ranking URL, search volume, difficulty and estimated traffic, highest traffic first. Costs API credits per call.

target.description: Domain (example.com) or full page URL (https://example.com/page) to analyze.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

limit.description: How many keywords to return, 10 to 1000. Default 100.

tools.name: find_competitor_keywords
tools.description: Competitor keywords: keywords a competitor domain ranks for in Google that your domain does not, with search volume, difficulty and the competitor's position. Costs API credits per call.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

limit.description: How many keywords to return, 10 to 1000. Default 100.

tools.name: find_competitor_domains
tools.description: Competitor domains: the domains competing with a domain in Google organic search, with shared keywords, average position and estimated traffic. Costs API credits per call.

domain.description: Domain or URL, for example example.com. Protocol and www are ignored.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

limit.description: How many competitors to return, 5 to 100. Default 20.
